(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 55 E qual è quei che volontieri acquista, 56 e giugne 'l tempo che perder lo face, 57 che 'n tutti suoi pensier piange e s'attrista; Reference Translation (provided): And such as he is who gaineth willingly, and the time arrives that makes him lose, who in all his thoughts weeps and is sad,

**Interpretation Lock – FIRST (one bullet per source line)**
- **Line 55** *E qual è quei che volontieri acquista,* → **Locked Meaning**: ∃ *x* [ *x* is the individual denoted by *quei* ∧ *qual è* asserts “such as he is” ∧ *volontieri acquista* holds of *x* (x willingly acquires/gains something) ].
- **Line 56** *e giugne 'l tempo che perder lo face,* → **Locked Meaning**: ∃ *t* [ *t* = “the time” ∧ *giugne* (t arrives) ∧ ∃ *x* (the same *x* from line 55) ∧ *che perder lo face* means “that makes x lose” (t causes x to lose) ].
- **Line 57** *che 'n tutti suoi pensier piange e s'attrista;* → **Locked Meaning**: ∀ *p* [ p ∈ *all his thoughts* → *x* weeps (πange) ∧ *x* becomes sad (s’attrista) ]; i.e., the same *x* weeps and is sad in every thought he has.
